resources.planning-rubric.md:
# Planning document review
- Check that the title and first section identify the purpose and intended reader.
- Verify every material claim against a pinned source, named observation, or unresolved assumption.
- Compare choices using their actual consequences. Keep constraints, conditions and omitted material traceable.
- Inspect the latest editable document and any separate recipient files. Test the explicit outcome when it can be observed.
